# Pharm Tech Basics

> Pharm Tech Basics is a free exam-prep app from Grip Theory LLC for the PTCE and ExCPT, with 459 practice questions, a rationale for every answer choice, and mock exams built to the official test plans.

- Publisher: Grip Theory LLC
- Price: free today, with no account and no ads. A paid plan, Pro, starts in January 2027; the question of the day, the daily plan, the Reference and one mock exam stay free.
- Platforms: Android (Google Play) and any web browser; the iPhone app is coming
- Practice questions: 459, each with a rationale for every answer choice

## Exams
- PTCE: 361 practice questions. Exam guide: https://pharmtechbasics.com/sheets/guide-ptcb-ptce.html. Sample questions: https://pharmtechbasics.com/practice/ptce.html
- ExCPT: 459 practice questions. Exam guide: https://pharmtechbasics.com/sheets/guide-nha-excpt.html. Sample questions: https://pharmtechbasics.com/practice/excpt.html

## Main pages
- [Home](https://pharmtechbasics.com/): what the app covers
- [Web app](https://pharmtechbasics.com/app/): the full question bank, free in any browser
- [Sample questions](https://pharmtechbasics.com/practice/): questions with answers and rationales
- [Cheat Sheets and exam guides](https://pharmtechbasics.com/sheets/): study summaries with sources
- [Reference](https://pharmtechbasics.com/reference/): every calculator, lab group and quick card set on its own page

## Reference
- [Calculators](https://pharmtechbasics.com/calculators/): 15 pages. Working calculators with the formula and how to read the result
- [Lab values](https://pharmtechbasics.com/labs/): 8 pages. Reference ranges in US and SI units
- [Quick cards](https://pharmtechbasics.com/cards/): 1 pages. Bedside tables and checklists
